title: "How much do you charge?"
when: First reply to a price question. Answer the price straight away - don't make them ask twice.
next_step: Mark as Replied (or Quote Sent if they named a service).

title: "Where are you located?"
when: Give the general area. Send the exact address only once they've booked.
next_step: Mark as Replied.
text: I'm in {area_line}. It's a garage setup, so it's drop-off - you leave the car with me and pick it up when it's done. I'll send the exact address once we lock in a time. Want me to send you what I have open?

title: "Do you come to me?"
when: Mobile requests. Be clear and friendly - don't leave any doubt.
next_step: Mark as Replied. If they can't drop off, mark Lost with reason 'needs mobile'.
text: I don't, sorry - I'm drop-off only right now. Everything I use is set up in my garage in {area_line}. If you're able to drop it off, I'd be happy to take care of it. {hours_line}.

title: "What does the $140 package include?"
when: Explaining the full package. Only list what you actually do (it comes from Settings).
next_step: Mark Quote Sent with service 'full'.
text:
The {price_full} package is both services in one drop-off:

Inside: {interior_includes}.
Outside: {exterior_includes}.

{turnaround_line}. Want me to send you some drop-off times?

title: "Do you have availability?"
when: Only real open slots from the Booking page are listed. If none are listed, add slots first - never guess.
next_step: After they pick one, use 'Offer this slot' on the lead, then Confirm once they say yes.

title: Pet hair / old stain / "can you get this out?"
when: Don't promise results you haven't seen. Ask for a photo.
next_step: Mark as Replied, follow up in 1 day.
text: Can you send me a picture of it? I'd rather tell you honestly what to expect before you book than promise something and have you disappointed.

title: No reply - first nudge (2 days)
when: They asked, you answered, then silence. One light nudge.
next_step: Use 'Log follow-up' and set next follow-up in 4 days.
text: Hey {name}, just checking back in case my last message got buried. Still want to get the car cleaned? No worries either way.

title: No reply - last message (about a week later)
when: Final follow-up. After this, mark Lost - don't keep messaging.
next_step: Log follow-up with no next date, then mark Lost (reason: no response).
text: Last one from me so I'm not blowing up your phone - if you ever want the car done, just text me. Interior {price_interior}, exterior {price_exterior}, both {price_full}. Take care!

title: Quote sent, no decision yet
when: They got a price but didn't pick a time.
next_step: Log follow-up, next in 3 days.
text: Hey {name}, any thoughts on the {service_label}? Happy to send you the open drop-off times if you want to grab one.

title: Booking confirmation
when: Right after they say yes to a time. Then press Confirm on the appointment.
next_step: Confirm the appointment in the app.

title: Reminder (day before)
when: The day before a confirmed appointment.
next_step: Press 'Reminder sent' on the appointment.
text: Hey {name}, quick reminder - drop-off is tomorrow ({appt_date}) at {appt_time} for the {appt_service}. Still good?

title: Car is ready
when: When you finish the job.
next_step: Mark the job completed and record payment.
text: Your car's ready, {name}! Come by whenever works for you. Total is {appt_price} ({payment_methods}).

title: They need to reschedule / cancel
when: Keep it easy. Cancel the appointment in the app so the slot opens back up.
next_step: Cancel the appointment (the slot re-opens automatically).

title: Review request (day after)
when: The day after a completed, paid job. Ask once. Never offer anything in exchange, and never ask only happy customers.
next_step: Press 'Review requested' on the lead.
text:
Thanks again for bringing your car in, {name}. If you have a minute, an honest review would really help a one-person shop like mine: {review_link}

And if anything wasn't right, tell me directly - I'd rather fix it.

title: Referral ask
when: With a happy customer, a few days after the job.
next_step: Log follow-up.
text: Hey {name}, if you know anyone who needs their car cleaned, I'd really appreciate you passing my number along. Most of my customers come from people telling people.

title: Repeat booking (about 5 weeks later)
when: Repeat follow-up date reached. No fake discounts - just a reminder.
next_step: Press 'Repeat offer sent' (next reminder in 60 days).

title: Answering a "Can anyone recommend a detailer?" post
when: When someone in a local group asks for a recommendation. Reply once; don't argue with other recommendations.
next_step: Log the effort under facebook_group. If they message you, add them as a lead.
text: I do detailing out of my garage in {area_line} - {business}. Drop-off only. Interior {price_interior}, exterior {price_exterior}, both {price_full}. Happy to answer questions, feel free to message me.

title: Intro to a local business (in person or via their public business contact)
when: One personal message to a business's PUBLIC business contact. Never mass-send. If they don't answer, one follow-up max.
next_step: Update the opportunity status to 'contacted' and set a follow-up date 7 days out.
text: Hi, I'm {owner_first_name} - I run {business}, a small drop-off detailing shop in {area_line}. I'm reaching out to a few local businesses to see if you'd be open to me leaving a few flyers, or if your customers ever ask about car cleaning. Interior {price_interior}, exterior {price_exterior}, both {price_full}. Totally fine if it's not a fit - thanks for reading.

title: First response to a new inquiry
when: The first reply to anyone who messages you. Fast and friendly.
next_step: Tap "I replied" on the lead.
text: Hey {name}, thanks for reaching out! I'd be glad to help. What kind of car is it, and are you thinking interior, exterior, or both? It's drop-off at my garage in {area_line}, and {turnaround_line}.

title: Questions to ask before quoting
when: Before you give an exact price. Photos stop surprises at pickup.
next_step: When they answer, send the quote.
text:
Happy to give you an exact price. A few quick questions:

1. What's the year, make and model?
2. Interior, exterior, or both?
3. Any pet hair, stains or anything I should know about?
4. Could you send 2-3 photos of the inside (front seats, back seat, floor)?

That way the price I give you is the price you pay.

title: Sending a quote
when: Once you know the car and what they want.
next_step: Use the Quote form on the lead, then follow up in a couple of days.
text:
Thanks {name}! For your car, the {service_label} would be {quote_price}. That's drop-off at my garage in {area_line}, {hours_line}, and {turnaround_line}. I take {payment_methods}.

Here's what I have open:
{open_times}

Want me to hold one of those for you?

title: Explaining what you don't offer
when: When someone asks for a service you don't do yet.
next_step: If that's all they wanted, mark the lead Lost with reason "service not offered".
text: Thanks for asking, {name}. Right now I don't offer {excludes_line}. I'm drop-off only at my garage in {area_line}. What I do offer is interior ({price_interior}), exterior ({price_exterior}) or both ({price_full}). If that works for you, I'd be glad to help.

title: Requesting payment
when: When a finished job still has a balance.
next_step: Record the payment on the lead when it comes in.
text: Hi {name}, thanks again for bringing your car in! Your total is {job_total} and the remaining balance is {balance}. You can pay with {payment_methods}. Let me know if you have any questions.

title: Booking terms
when: Send with a confirmation if you want customers to know your policies up front. Review your policies first (More > Policies & readiness).
next_step: Confirm the appointment.

title: Reconnecting with a past customer
when: Someone you detailed a while ago. Only people who've done business with you.
next_step: Tap "Reconnect message sent" on the lead.
